# C.B. Jha Tutorials

> Premier academic coaching, verified home tuition network, residential hostel, and school staffing institution based in Patna, Bihar. Founded in 2009 by Chandra Bhushan Jha. MSME Registered.

## Organization Details
- **Full Name**: C.B. Jha Tutorials

## Core Educational Services (The 4 Pillars)

- [Academic Coaching](https://www.cbjhatutorials.in/academic-coaching): Small-batch classroom coaching (15–20 students) for Class 6 to 12 across CBSE, ICSE, and Bihar State Board. Comprehensive Science, Mathematics, Commerce, and Arts preparation.
- [Home Tuition Network](https://www.cbjhatutorials.in/home-tuition): 1-on-1 personalized home tutoring across Patna with multi-stage verified educators, background checks, subject tests, free demo classes, and replacement guarantees.
- [Service Areas](https://www.cbjhatutorials.in/home-tuition/service-areas): Home tutoring coverage across Bailey Road, Kankarbagh, Boring Road, Rajendra Nagar, Danapur, Rupaspur, Ashiana Nagar, Anisabad, Patliputra, and Greater Patna.
- [School Staffing Solutions](https://www.cbjhatutorials.in/school-staffing): Institutional teacher placement for schools across Bihar. Fast 24–48 hour turnaround for qualified guest teachers and screened permanent faculty with a 30-day replacement guarantee.
- [Residential Hostel Care](https://www.cbjhatutorials.in/residential-hostel): Supervised boarding, 3 nutritious meals daily, strictly monitored curfew, and evening doubt clearing for outstation students preparing for board exams and entrance tests.

## Key Institutional Facts
- **Students Guided**: Over 10,000+ students guided since 2009.
- **Tutor Network**: 200+ active verified tutors across Patna.
- **Partner Schools**: 50+ institutional partners across Bihar.
- **Board Curriculums**: CBSE, ICSE / ISC, and Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB).
- **Core Philosophy**: "Every student who walks through our door deserves a teacher who believes in them."
